items.note: The plan follows the proof of Lemma lem:scalar-motifs step by step (741-765): it subtracts Ja+Rc, applies the rows, gets the net change (JV+RG)x, gives the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2, composes the three stages to (-y,x), and adds the neighbour and wire counts (767-782). It names the copy, gather, scatter and side-injection maps only through the coefficients they produce, and it does not say that stage j varies coordinate j.

Shared gate frames, the edge operator D_vD_u^{-1}, the invariant argued by induction, commutation with the pointwise gate, D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} on all roles all match 793-825.

The plan gives the bilinear forms, terminal labels, interstage transitions, the eight gate labels (975-988), the full residual table (1022-1043), the single loss on center 3->4, the telescoping to Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The lemma's last clause, that binary residuals have orthonormal bases (1073-1102), is not derived; S0.1.1.1.4.9 only presupposes it. S0.1.1.1.4.6.14 wrongly ties the 0->2 side edge to orthogonality (see errors).

The plan matches the proof at 1156-1171: the projections P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at the sources, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N extra rank-one edges 2P_{U_a}, the sum s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, and the endpoint difference I_m. The Phi_M frames and the resulting shear on every role appear in S0.1.1.2.1.4.

The plan matches the proof at 1231-1315: weight is additive mod 4 under orthogonality, basis vectors have odd weight, each phase becomes a translation kernel through H, the totals give s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c with deficit 2N-2L_c, the X_a->Y_a pair carries C^{-1} on 27 coordinates, and the Z wrappers with i^{27k} make it forward. Writing mu,nu for a,b is a harmless renaming.

The plan has L<N/2 from the exact ratios, both strict inequalities s<Wm, the deficits 339/22587335000000 and 73/19906842167500, and the comparison m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta) from log m<20 (1331-1338). The conclusion s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50 matches the paper.

Neither Lemma lem:elementary-streams nor lem:ordered-affine-streams is stated. Steps use their consequences (O(V) lower-triangular updates, the cyclic row split, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts) and list them as relies-on concepts, but no step gives the O(V) contract or the b^{O(1)} offset condition.

The plan reproduces both lemmas and their proofs: elimination at the topmost row's rightmost pivot, a fixed odd prime avoiding denominators, O(V) triangular passes in descending order, conjugation of Pi by E_1 and E_2, and the three-step swap realizing H_i<-H_i+D_j with one interchange per one of Pi. Writing q^k for q^b is only a change of notation.

The plan follows 1491-1588: the contract eq:finite-shear-contract, the cyclic split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} per edge by matrix shears, f'=Phi_{I_m}f on every role, a merge that undoes rho, the three-shear interchange, exactly s calls, the fixed-tape parking schedule, and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) giving O(e^tau).

Every step of the proof at 1649-1734 appears, plus the unequal-width remark (1740-1762): rho high digits as the row field with q^{2rho}>=W^k, zero-row padding to R'<2R, base-m pieces summing to O(Ve^tau), and padding [2^u] to [q^e] at a factor below q^2.

The plan matches 1814-1940: the identities for C and H_0, the edge product over a residual basis, conjugation by P_M (which needs only invertibility), slots and columns with one child per basis vector, inverse children via (-i)^f Z C Z, at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, exactly s_c children on e/m axes, and H_0^{(x)D}=b^D S_D C^{(x)D} S_D.

The plan follows 2013-2231: the eight operations and their cycles, (u+c(1-2(u mod 2)),w), guard segments, the bad set with 20 excluded values per guard and delta_bad, T_0S_0^{-1} permuting B, sixteen swaps and eight rotations, the radix-sort repair, the top position handled separately, and the family simplification to O(V((eK)^tau+1)) per change of basis.

The plan covers the node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), the q_0 row chunks with padding to a multiple of W^{k_0}, children of volume exactly V/W, the recurrence with leaves O(e) below d^beta, K<=e^{c/beta}, the internal sum O(e^lambda), the leaf bound O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), and the base-m sum O(d^{lambda'}), all as at 2286-2445.

The plan states that the layer is exact and then truncated once, in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error <sqrt2 2^{-p}. It derives the guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E as in 2457-2586, and closes with the row-sum-one disk argument (2751-2757). The bands of the cost check in the proof (2696-2735) are compressed into S0.1.1.3.2.14.

Every part of 2819-2915 and 2990-3200 appears: character cancellation through the k+t/2^{v+1} shift and the absence of 2-torsion, decimation in frequency into bit-reversed order, the reversed procedure giving F^+B^{-1}, the prefix moves and chunk exchanges defining L, the cost terms dK, pK^{tau-1} and l d^{lambda'}, and the odd-truncation commutation giving the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}.

The plan matches 3233-3368: B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, carries in {-1,0} and {0,1}, centered residues, the negacyclic reduction, and a cost dominated by the four products.

The plan matches 3414-3495: retained LB order, the identity P(LBu,LBv)=LBP(u,v), the normalization F^-(f*g)=M F^-f F^-g, error chaining to M(3delta+eta)=sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, and M=T/r products costing O(Tp log(rp)).

The plan matches 3576-3696: the identity TP_sF_s=P_tF_tS, N=CTD with ||N-I||<1/2, the Neumann inverse, the rescalings with product 2^{-2alpha^2}, the error and time table, the ordered selection C, and the remark that the original proof sorted the permutations. The tensor form, gamma=2d alpha^2 and the exposure cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) are in S0.1.3.

The plan follows 3938-3982 for both identities: periodicity of the chirp, the coefficient that equals the QF_t kernel, F^+R=R^{-1}F^+, commutation with pointwise products, and the two normalizations giving (u*v)/S^2. The lemma's last clause, obtaining RF^+ by complex conjugation (3934-3935, 3983-3987), is not in the plan.

The plan has the fixed constants, the sizes b, p, d, K, T, r and t_i, the comparison bands, alpha and gamma, the prime window through Rosser-Schoenfeld, T/2<S<T by Bernoulli, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the n^{o(1)} search, and the no-wraparound and capacity facts, as at 4004-4193.

The plan follows 4216-4291: the isomorphism from the order of the image of x, the triangular digit formula, updates in order i=d..1, preservation of the valid box, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and O(d^2) axis moves costing O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)).

Well-definedness, the diagonal isomorphism and the wrap-sign check follow 4308-4319, and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g) is stated. The computed sequence (4374-4392) and the twist errors of 4 each (S0.1.14.3, 4607-4618) are included, though the computed version is only an inferred step.

The source transform (A, chirp, B_0, 2^gamma, exact counterpart RF_s), the digit scaling 2^{-b-2}, the six steps and the role of the two S factors all match 4456-4544. The plan never defines the opposite procedure F~^+(z)=conj(F~(conj z)) (4478-4484), which S0.1.13.5 uses.

The plan chains every error bound in the paper's order: E_ring<5TL, the convolution <6TL, the chirp <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, the pointwise product 2E_s+2, the opposite transform 3E_s+2, E_w<28*2^gamma T^2L, and the final <448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2. It then covers exact rounding and the carry invariant. The disk margins (.7, .701, .5) are only implicit.

The plan has the seven table rows and their powers, the margins with min g_i=2^{-181}=2kappa, the row justifications, the setup bound p^{A+C}=o(Tp), the absorption of log p powers, the bound O(Tp p^{1-kappa}), and the schoolbook cutoff. The o(V) cost of sorting the exceptional streams (4951-4973) is named in the method but has no step.
S0 says the bound disproves the n log n conjecture, as the abstract does (line 32). No step gives the eventual-lower-bound formulation or the liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 argument at 379-387.

errors.says: The side wire edge 0->2 has residual of dimension (a-1)(h-1)+1, 'using that the two triples are orthogonal'.
errors.paper: The inclusion B(x)<t_Y> into (B(x)F)perp(P(x)<t_X>) and its residual (B(x)t_Y^perp)perp(P(x)<t_X>) need no orthogonality. The paper says it is the side edge 2->5 that 'uses the neighbor relation essentially'.

errors.says: Motivation: the deficit Wm-s 'equals twice the total number of loss minus source ranks'.
errors.paper: The deficit is N-2L_b for the bit network and 2N-2L_c for the complex one. It is positive because L<N/2, so it is the source term minus twice the loss, not twice the loss minus the source ranks.

errors.says: The labels are built from triple indicators 'pairing as |sigma cap sigma'|-1' in both the bit and the complex network.
errors.paper: The form <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1 is used only for the bit network's rational labels. The complex network uses F_2^h with the ordinary dot product. S0.1.1.1.4.1 gives this correctly.

errors.says: The recurrence 'solves to a cost O(e^tau) ... for the bit network and O(e^lambda) in the complex one'.
errors.paper: For the complex network the internal costs sum to O(e^lambda), but the leaves contribute O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), which need not be O(e^lambda). The layer bound is O(d^{lambda'}) with lambda'>max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}. Child S0.1.1.1.6.2 states this correctly.

chain: The tree reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route. The rank-saving network (network, frames, labels, rank budget, deficit, exponent) feeds the power-width and arbitrary-width interchanges and the phase-frame layer. These feed the synthetic transforms, ring convolution, twist, chirp, resampling and CRT steps, then the six-step algorithm, exact recovery, and a time table whose minimum margin is 2kappa. It thins out only at the edges: the elementary and controlled-shift stream lemmas are never stated, the opposite source transform defined by conjugation is never given, the orthonormal-basis existence over F_2 is assumed, and the conjecture-refutation step is only asserted.

steps.note: h=100, v=binom(h,3), N=v^3 and m=h^3 are given. Triple indexing is explicit in u_a=t_{a1}(x)t_{a2}(x)t_{a3}(x), and the forward-inverse-forward stages send (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire.
A common frame commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge pays only D_vD_u^{-1}, as at 806-825.
Gates get nondegenerate subspaces of F^{(x)3} of dimension m. Every edge joins comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges are center 3->4, each losing h (P(x)F(x)Q).
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels, with the N source edges 2P_{U_a} as rank-one exceptions.
The budget sum|Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and hence s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, both come with the telescoping argument.

L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are both below 1/2, and s_b<W_b m and s_c<W_c m are stated. The positive deficit is explicit for the complex network (2N-2L_c) and follows for the bit network from s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with L_b<N/2.
P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, with every other role having zero source and identity sink, gives f'_{rho(w)}=Phi_{I_m}f_w. That is the shear H<-H+D on every role, scratch roles included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a ones, a shear costing exactly a interchanges plus O(V), each edge Phi_{A_e} done recursively, and exactly s recursive calls per node.
Children have volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) is solved by the geometric sum to O(e^tau), and tau=1-2^-50 is justified by eta>20*2^-50 and log m<20.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs all nine links of the central saving with their defining content and in the paper's order. The fixed bank-exchange network gets frames, then nested subspace labels whose only loss is h per central 3->4 edge. Ranks equal dimension changes except for the N source edges, which gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, and L/N<1/2 makes the deficit strict. The endpoint identity makes the shear H<-H+D on every role, each edge costs its rank in recursive interchanges, and the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with s/W<m^{1-2^-50} gives O(e^tau). The only blemishes are minor wording slips in a motivation and one residual-table row.
